import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    df = inputs["RATE_FEED"].copy()

    # Order exactly as the cursor would: account_id, obs_date, obs_seq
    df = df.sort_values(
        by=["account_id", "obs_date", "obs_seq"],
        kind="mergesort"  # stable sort to mimic deterministic cursor ordering
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    # Forward-fill rate within each account_id group (carry never crosses accounts)
    rate_filled = df.groupby("account_id")["rate"].ffill()

    # carried = 1 only when original rate was NULL and a prior non-null rate existed
    was_carried = ((df["rate"].isna()) & (rate_filled.notna())).astype("int64")

    result = pd.DataFrame({
        "account_id": df["account_id"],
        "obs_seq": df["obs_seq"],
        "obs_date": df["obs_date"],
        "rate_filled": rate_filled,
        "was_carried": was_carried,
    })

    return {"rate_filled": result}
